# UltraViolet — Full Brand Context

## About

UltraViolet is a Vietnamese streetwear brand launched in 2026. The brand was built for those who move with intention — not for the crowd, not for the algorithm. Every product carries weight in both craft and meaning. UltraViolet exists outside the box: hard edges, clean execution, and a visual language entirely its own.

The brand produces limited-run apparel alongside original cinematic short films (UV Films), treating content as an inseparable part of the product experience rather than an afterthought.

## SS26 Collection

### Signature Adjustable Cap
A premium structured cap featuring gold script UltraViolet embroidery, adjustable snapback closure, and a rigid structured crown. One size fits most. Flagship product of the SS26 collection.

### UV Signature Skullcap
A fitted skullcap with gold script embroidery and premium structured crown. One size fits most. Part of the SS26 collection.

### UV Signature Belt (Coming Soon)
A signature belt currently in development.

## UV Films (Cinema)

UltraViolet produces original short films released alongside each collection drop. The films are cinematic, deliberate, and built to move culture beyond product promotion.

- UV001: The Call (2026)
- UV002: A Language (2026)
- UV003: The Deal (2026)
- UV004: Setup (2026)

## Brand Philosophy

"Not a logo. A language."

UltraViolet was built for those who already know what they stand for before they put anything on. The brand's streetwear speaks before the wearer does — hard edges, clean execution, and visual language that is entirely its own. From the caps to the films to the way the brand moves, every decision is intentional. Nothing is an accident.

## Shipping

International orders. Processing time: 1–2 business days. Delivery: 4–6 business days after shipping. Tracking number provided by email. International orders may be subject to duties and taxes. The buyer assumes full responsibility for the package upon purchase.
